description: Copernicium is a synthetic chemical element with symbol Cn and atomic number 112. It is a d-block transactinide element and a group 12 element in the periodic table. All known isotopes are extremely radioactive and have only been created in laboratory settings.
uses: Copernicium has no practical uses due to its extreme radioactivity and the difficulty of synthesizing it. It is primarily studied for scientific research purposes, with its chemical properties being experimentally investigated as one of the heaviest elements in this regard.
characteristics: Copernicium is calculated to be an extremely volatile element, possibly a gas or volatile liquid at standard temperature and pressure. It is predicted to differ significantly from lighter group 12 elements due to relativistic effects, potentially showing the +4 oxidation state and having chemical similarities to noble gases. The most stable known isotope, copernicium-285, has a half-life of approximately 30 seconds.
